criteria: Not present in this note at all
Barely present - mentioned once, in passing

question.instructions: Setting aside specific descriptors, how positive is the overall emotional tone and word choice of the note taken as a whole (warm, admiring language throughout vs. flat, neutral, or lukewarm phrasing)?

standard_answer.note:
因为这次评的是整段的总体情绪基调，而不是有没有一句强烈的总结性 verdict。整段几乎一直采用正面措辞：
- very much wine
- structure and richness are just right
- ripe acidity
- dense, complex structure
- maturity
- tight apple skin finish
没有明显负面或犹豫措辞，因此整体读起来是持续肯定、欣赏的。
但还不到 Dominant（4），因为它仍然主要是在做专业的感官描述，而不是通篇用高度赞美性的语言。
